question: In the context of the passage, select the most appropriate option to fill in blank (3).
solution:
The correct answer is '**its**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage is referring to the growth of the green economy in India.
 
• The word "India" is a singular noun, and the appropriate possessive pronoun for singular nouns is "its."
 
• "**Its**" correctly reflects that the green economy is something belonging to India.
